NoSQLServer v0.37 validation
============================

Focus
-----
SQL aggregate FILTER (WHERE ...) for grouped projections and HAVING.

New SQL surface
---------------
- COUNT(...) FILTER (WHERE predicate)
- SUM(...) FILTER (WHERE predicate)
- AVG(...) FILTER (WHERE predicate)
- MIN(...) FILTER (WHERE predicate)
- MAX(...) FILTER (WHERE predicate)
- FILTER predicates use the existing predicate evaluator and SQL NULL rules.
- FILTER may be used in SELECT aggregate projections and inside HAVING.
